mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 3% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth above 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6% signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressure and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to expected inflation.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE below 6%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 550,000 units and retail sales (RSAFS) growth is above 3% MoM, it signals a consumption boom, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1.5-year rolling window with joint trigger conditions met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 2% YoY signals strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters with INDPRO YoY growth above 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 2% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a monetary tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1.5-year rolling window with joint trigger conditions met.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below 2% YoY signals decreased inflation pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to expected monetary accommodation.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 55% of instances with CPIAUCSL YoY growth below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth below 100,000 MoM signals weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with PAYEMS MoM growth below 100,000.
